scope: Offline descriptive frame-weighted diagnostics, continuous boxes, no model/images or parameter selection. First frame and nonpositive GT excluded. Width/height use each fixed sensor GT separately. Own-hit cohorts differ by model; joint-hit comparisons fix the same frames for both models. Crop rows exclude both-missing hold frames, require all annotation GT valid, and accept support from either annotation. Crop/GT intersection is geometric support, not visible pixels or reliable identity. Test trajectories previously used for failure diagnosis; these are not additional benchmark scores or causal module interventions.
